description: Revert to the proven optimal Total Batch Size (2^19) to maximize gradient signal-to-noise ratio and stability, as the previous reduction to 2^18 yielded a worse result (0.9881 vs 0.9891) likely due to noisy gradients preventing convergence to the sharper minimum, while maintaining the optimal Depth (8), Matrix LR (0.11), and Embedding LR (1.4).
